turns.text: am I a HIP or a HIU?

must_contain: a HIP publishes records it created and a HIU requests records held elsewhere
one system can be both, and the role is per interaction
must_not_contain: HIP and HIU are the same
notes: Source lines: catalogue/hiecm/concepts/roles.md, 'The entity publishing a record is the HIP... The entity fetching one is the HIU. This changes call by call, and either entity can take either role.'; catalogue/shared/glossary/hip.md, 'The role is per interaction, not per product and not per company.'
